shadow.$description: Elevation shadow GEOMETRY. Offsets, blur, and spread are px lengths; the colour here is the light-mode value and is the raw source, not the binding. Consumers bind the colour to the semantic `shadow` role so it resolves per brightness — see semantic/color.{light,dark}.tokens.json. A shadow colour that does not vary by mode is a glow on a dark surface.

shadow10.$description: Hairline separation ring — separates a surface from its background WITHOUT reading as elevation. Zero offset and zero blur: it is a 1px ring, not a cast shadow. Distinct in intent from shadow100, which is elevation. Its colour also binds to a per-mode role (the subtle border role rather than the shadow role) so the ring stays visible on a dark surface.

shadow100.$description: Base ambient elevation shadow for raised surfaces.
